email.automated: This is an automated message from PeopleForge, the Sirius Group HR portal. Please don't reply to it.

body.one: Your increment request {reference} with {count} employee was submitted to Sirius HR. Sirius HR reviews it criterion by criterion; you'll be told when they respond.
body.other: Your increment request {reference} with {count} employees was submitted to Sirius HR. Sirius HR reviews it criterion by criterion; you'll be told when they respond.

body.one: {actor} submitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} employee. It is waiting for your review.
body.other: {actor} submitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} employees. It is waiting for your review.

stage_changed.subject: {reference}: criterion {criterion} of {of} under review
stage_changed.body: Sirius HR verified the earlier criteria of increment request {reference} for every employee. Criterion {criterion} of {of} is now under review.

employee_approved.subject: {employee} approved in {reference}
employee_approved.body: Sirius HR approved the increment for {employee} in request {reference}. Open the request to see the approved figures.

employee_rejected.subject: {employee} rejected in {reference}
employee_rejected.body: Sirius HR rejected the increment for {employee} in request {reference}. Open the request to see the reason.

employee_returned.subject: Action needed: {employee} returned in {reference}
employee_returned.body: Sirius HR returned {employee} in request {reference} with a question. Update the employee and resubmit.

request_decided.subject: {reference} decided: {status}
request_decided.body: Sirius HR decided every employee in increment request {reference}. Final status: {status}.

body.one: {actor} resubmitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} returned employee. It is waiting for your review.
body.other: {actor} resubmitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} returned employees. It is waiting for your review.
